answer: Every new agent posts a bond of 40 POA that vests in a velvet-smooth ramp over 8 epochs, and its signal weight is capped at bond divided by 40. Each extra identity from the same orchard of funding sources needs a bond 1.5x larger than the previous one, so ten fakes cost over 4,500 POA. Validators recompute clusters from the ledger every epoch and slash bonds on mismatch.
